* Body

Mira rewrote the token expiry comparison to use monotonic clock sources instead of wall-clock timestamps, eliminating the leap-second race entirely. She added unit tests that simulate clock jumps forward and backward, and an integration test that floods the validator with near-expiry tokens. The fix passed code review and was merged into the auth refactor branch by evening. Checkout's staging environment showed zero regressions under replayed production traffic.
